messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: version 0.5-1 of NIMBLE released
parts:
Dear nimble-users and nimble-announce,

We're pleased to announce that we've released version 0.5-1 of NIMBLE at
R-nimble.org.

Version 0.5-1 is officially a minor release but it actually has quite
a bit going on, particularly in terms of new and improved algorithms.
Highlights include:
- the addition of a variety of sequential Monte Carlo (aka particle
filtering) algorithms, including particle MCMC samplers for use within
an MCMC (thanks to our 2015 Google Summer of Code student, Nick
Michaud)
- a greatly improved MCEM algorithm with an automated convergence and
stopping criterion (also thanks to Nick)
- new syntax for declaring multivariate variables in the NIMBLE DSL,
namely numeric(), integer(), matrix(), and array(), with declare() now
deprecated,
- addition of the multivariate-t distribution for use in BUGS and DSL
code (thanks to a Berkeley masters student, Peter Sujan),
- a new binary MCMC sampler for discrete 0/1 nodes,
- addition of functionality to our random walk sampler to allow
sampling on the log scale and use of reflection,
- more flexible use of forwardsolve(), backsolve(), and solve(),
including use in BUGS code, and
- some speed improvements in building and compiling models and algorithms.

More details on the NIMBLE web page and the NEWS file of the package.

We've had a bit of a hiccup in terms of getting on CRAN (some issues with
linking shared object files in a robust way when building package binaries)
but anticipate that happening in June, in addition to another release
that should bring
some major improvements in the speed of building and compiling models
with many nodes.

- Chris Paciorek for the NIMBLE Development Team

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: NIMBLE version 0.5-1 fixed for Windows
parts:
Dear nimble-users and nimble-announce,

Friday’s release of NIMBLE version 0.5-1 had a glitch for Windows installation. That has been corrected. If you experience a problem installing it on Windows, sorry and please try again. And please let me know directly or via nimble-users if there are any further problems.

Perry
